missing_data_policy.mice: IterativeImputer with BayesianRidge to model feature-conditional missing values.
missing_data_policy.knn: KNNImputer with distance weighting for local-neighborhood imputation.
missing_data_policy.categorical: Most-frequent imputation plus unknown-safe one-hot encoding.

robustness_policy.outliers: Clip numeric features at train-set 1st/99th percentiles inside the pipeline.
robustness_policy.scaling: RobustScaler for median/IQR scaling where appropriate.
robustness_policy.robust_regression: HuberRegressor reduces sensitivity to large target residuals.
robustness_policy.target_transform: Linear robust/basis models use log1p target fitting with expm1 predictions.

nonlinearity_policy.polynomial_features: Degree-2 numeric basis for curvature and pairwise products.
nonlinearity_policy.interaction_only_features: Pairwise numeric interactions without squared terms.
nonlinearity_policy.splines: Cubic spline basis for smooth nonlinear numeric effects.
nonlinearity_policy.tree_models: Random forest and histogram gradient boosting capture higher-order interactions.

industry_readiness_policy.data_contract: Train-derived schema, missingness, numeric range, and categorical-level contract.
industry_readiness_policy.leakage_audit: Column-name and target-correlation checks to flag suspicious fields.
industry_readiness_policy.validation_strategy: Documented holdout and KFold assumptions with alternatives.
industry_readiness_policy.metric_design: RMSE primary with MAE, RMSLE, and R2 as secondary checks.
industry_readiness_policy.baselines_first: Dummy median baseline is included in every model comparison.
